+## Native parallel NDD
+
+An additive C11 core with a Java JNI API now supports BDD, BCDD, ZDD, BITSET,
+and mixed fields. It uses a shared Lace worker pool for NDD, label and batch tasks.
+The existing Java engine remains available as a baseline. Build instructions,
+API ownership, collection boundaries and reproducible N-Queens experiments are
+in [native/README.md](native/README.md). Implementation status and measurements
+are documented in [the parallel implementation report](doc/parallel-implementation.md).
+
 ## The Origin of NDD
 
 NDD was originally proposed for network verification, where each NDD node represents a packet header field (destination IP address)
